vsm.title: Memory
vsm.intro: What this Vibe Space remembers. Only for this space. You can delete anything.
vsm.add.title: Title (optional)
vsm.clearAll: Delete all memory in this space
vsm.clearAll.confirm: Delete all {count} items? This cannot be undone.
vsm.vector.title: Search by meaning (optional)
vsm.vector.off: Off. Keyword search works without it.
vsm.vector.explain: Finds related notes even when the words differ. It needs a language model of {size} on your computer. Nothing is downloaded until you confirm, and nothing leaves your machine when searching.
vsm.vector.ack: I agree to store search vectors of this space's memory on this computer.
vsk.title: Skills
vsk.intro: Skills are instructions your agent can use. Installing a skill never runs anything.
vsk.banner.unreviewed: Unreviewed: instructions only, scripts are disabled.
vsk.scripts.off: Scripts cannot run in this version.
vsk.scan.caveat: A clean scan is not a safety guarantee.
vsk.install.note: Shows everything first. Nothing is executed.
vsk.index.unavailable: Browsing the index is not available in this build.
vsk.index.consent: Load the public index from the internet
